notes.title: Patch for version 0.2
notes.content:
•	If your cursor is over an item, it displays that item’s name
•	Picking up items is now much easier
•	Create a corpse image that is unique
•	Increase lifetime of enemy corpses

notes.title: Storms 2 Playtest Update – Beta 2.6
notes.content:
•	Saving and quitting in a dungeon caused glitches – now saving underground is disabled.
•	Made sweeping changes to the interface for the skill tree
      o	Reworked the GUI’s appearance
      o	More details about a skill can be viewed (levels 1-10)
      o	Mana cost is now displayed as Low, Medium, or High
•	Fixed a bug with invading enemies one-shotting the player
•	Adjusted the skill Raven
•	Adjusted the skill Sap
•	Fixed bugs with the skill Sap
      o	Now has a maximum amount of life stolen
      o	Now is destroyed when the target dies
      o	Now does not disappear early
•	Fixed a bug with the skill Curse
•	Adjusted the skill Whirlwind
•	Adjusted the skill Double Throw
•	Adjusted the skill tree’s zoom limits
•	Nerfed the skill River
•	Made the “rivers” from the skill River look more like rivers
•	Changed up the music for CoT
•	Fixed subtitles for The Wanderer’s dialogue
•	Lowered drop rates for magic, rare, and unique items
      o	Unique items now have a base drop rate of 1% for regular enemies, instead of 5%
      o	Boss drop rates are unchanged
•	Lowered the damage from .55 to .4 for the skill Waterball
•	Increased the mana cost of the skill Waterball from .6 to .8
•	Fixed a bug where spells would add spell modifiers twice
•	Lowered all player spell damage by 9%
•	Fixed a bug with ranged enemies using wands
•	Added functionality for the affix Percent Light Spell Power
•	Increased enemy health by 6%
•	Increased boss health by 20%

notes.title: Storms 2 Playtest – Beta 2.5
notes.content:
[h3]Storms 2 Playtest – Beta 2.5 Update
[/h3]
9/25/2021

•	Moved the library entrance east about 5 units
•	Changed the library entrance background
•	Fixed a bug where your stash would disappear upon using a portal in the library
•	Fixed a bug where an area would not be properly loaded upon using a waypoint, portal, or upon starting the game.
•	Fixed a bug where cutscenes would end early
•	Increased player movement speed from 4.8 to 5.4 units
•	Nerfed the unique item Sandman’s Beak Hood
•	Added descriptions to attributes on the attributes screen.
•	Fixed the damage of Combustion overtime
•	Reworked much of the skill tree interface
•	Fixed an issue with the skill Raven
•	Altered the duration of the skill Deer
•	Lowered the range of the skill Leap

notes.title: Storms 2 Playtest - Beta 2.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Fixed issues with the unique item Black Knight's Field Plate[/h3]
     * One of the affixes were labeled "None" - changed to % Spell Lifetime
     * The item had an affix for 100 life - reduced to 20

[h3]Fixed issues with the unique item White Knight's Field Plate
[/h3] 
     * One of the affixes were labeled "None".
     * The item had an affix for 100 life - reduced to 20
     * Changed life affix to apply during the day instead of night

[h3]Made the unique socketable stone Oldstone the correct size

Fixed a bug where killing Bull Lord did not save

Made all health bars transparent

Made all health bars thinner

Added functionality to the following item stats:[/h3]
     * No Water Resistance
     * No Lightning Resistance
          * Also applied this to stats screen - if this stat is enabled, lightning resistance is shown as '0'
     * All skills

[h3]Fixed a bug with invading enemies dealing approximately 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 damage upon striking

Changed the image for the following objects:[/h3]
     * Horizontal CoT road
     * Vertical CoT road
     * CoT crossroad
     * CoT background
     * CoT town backgrounds
[h3]Added sound effects for basically all standard items[/h3]
     * Wands, helmets, armor, etc.
[h3]Added corrected sound effects to starting items[/h3]

[h3]Increased the health of all enemies by about 15%

Increased the size of the trigger for Samander's entrance

Sped up Samander from a speed of 4 to 4.5

Fixed Samander dialogue[/h3]
     Dialogue for starting his quest

[h3]* Fixed Scholar dialogue[/h3]
     Dialogue for his quest

[h3]Made a transparent and grey background for the dialogue text

Increased the size of the dialogue text

Moved the dialogue text to above the current speaking NPC

Fixed bugs with Samander's quest[/h3]
     * Instead of requiring 5 orbs, he requires 6
     * Samander's opening dialogue only plays once now
     * Samander properly says his quest lines

[h3]Fixed bugs where the wanderer, Samander, and the Scholar thought they had greetings
Changed the CoT theme

There are probably more bugs and stuff that I fixed but I'm gonna call this good.[/h3]
